50815746.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to FXR (unknown origin) ligand binding domain by ITC assay

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC) experiments were performed on a MicroCal iTC200 (Malvern Instruments, Worcestershire, U.K.) at 25 °C. The FXR-LBD (10 μM) was dialyzed against 20 mM HEPES, 100 mM NaCl, 1 mM DTT, 0.02% CHAPS, pH 7.4, and loaded into the sample cell. The ligand (58, 100 μM) was dissolved in the same buffer and loaded into the syringe. The titration consisted of 20 injections of 2 μL each, with a 120 s spacing between injections. The data were analyzed using Origin 7.0 software (OriginLab, Northampton, MA) with a one-site binding model. The binding constant (Kd), enthalpy change (ΔH), and stoichiometry (n) were determined from the fit. A control experiment with buffer in the syringe was performed to correct for heat of dilution.

assay_conditions.buffer_composition: 20 mM HEPES, 100 mM NaCl, 1 mM DTT, 0.02% CHAPS
assay_conditions.control_method: A control experiment with buffer in the syringe was performed to correct for heat of dilution.
